mn64:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn64:2.1: dhāretha no tumhe bhikkhave mayā desitāni pañcorambhāgiyāni saññojanānīti.
mn64:2.2: evaṃ vutte āyasmā māluṅkyaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
mn64:2.3: ahaṃ kho bhante dhāremi bhagavatāo desitāni pañcorambhāgiyāni saññojanānīti.
mn64:2.4: yathākathaṃ pana tvaṃ māluṅkyaputta dhāresi mayā desitāni pañcorambhāgiyāni saññojanānīti.
mn64:2.5: sakkāyadiṭṭhiṃ kho ahaṃ bhante bhagavatā orambhāgiyaṃ saññojanaṃ desitaṃ dhāremi
mn64:2.6: vicikicchaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante bhagavatā orambhāgiyaṃ saññojanaṃ desitaṃ dhāremi
mn64:2.7: sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante bhagavatā orambhāgiyaṃ saññojanaṃ desitaṃ dhāremi
mn64:2.8: kāmacchandaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante bhagavatā orambhāgiyaṃ saññojanaṃ desitaṃ dhāremi
mn64:2.9: byāpādaṃ kho ahaṃ bhagavatā orambhāgiyaṃ saññojanaṃ desitaṃ dhāremi
mn64:2.10: evaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante dhāremi bhagavatā desitāni pañcorambhāgiyāni saññojanānīti.
mn64:3.1: kassa nu kho nāma tvaṃ māluṅkyaputta mayā imāni evaṃ pañcorambhāgiyāni saññojanāni desitāni dhāresi.
mn64:3.2: nanu māluṅkyaputta aññatitthiyā paribbājakā iminā taruṇūpamena upārambhena upārambhissanti
mn64:3.3: daharassa hi māluṅkyaputta kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa sakkāyotipi na hoti kuto panassa uppajjissati sakkāyadiṭṭhi
mn64:3.5: daharassa hi māluṅkyaputta kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa dhammātipi na hoti kuto panassa uppajjissati dhammesu vicikicchā
mn64:3.7: daharassa hi kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa sīlātipi na hoti kuto panassa uppajjissati sīlesu sīlabbattaparāmāso anuseti
mn64:3.9: daharassa hi māluṅkyaputta kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa kāmātipi na hoti kuto panassa uppajjissati kāmesu kāmacchando
mn64:3.11: daharassa hi māluṅkyaputta kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa sattātipi na hoti kuto panassa uppajjissati sattesu byāpādo
mn64:3.13: nanu māluṅkyaputta aññatitthiyā paribbājakā iminā taruṇūpamena upārambhena upārambhissantīti.
mn64:4.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
mn64:4.2: etassa bhagavā kālo etassa sugata kālo
mn64:4.3: yaṃ bhagavā pañcorambhāgiyāni saññojanāni deseyya bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantīti.
mn64:4.5: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi.
mn64:5.1: idhānanda assutavā puthujjano ariyānaṃ adassāvī ariyadhammassa akovido ariyadhamme avinīto sappurisānaṃ adassāvī sappurisadhammassa akovido sappurisadhamme avinīto
mn64:5.3: uppannāya ca sakkāyadiṭṭhiyā nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti
mn64:5.4: tassa sā sakkāyadiṭṭhi thāmagatā appaṭivinītā orambhāgiyasaññojanaṃ.
mn64:5.6: uppannāya ca vicikicchāya nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti
mn64:5.7: tassa sā vicikicchā thāmagatā appaṭivinītā orambhāgiyasaññojanaṃ. sīlabbattaparāmāsapariyuṭṭhitena
mn64:5.9: uppannassa ca sīlabbattaparāmāsassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti
mn64:5.10: tassa so sīlabbattaparāmāso thāmagato appaṭivinīto orambhāgiyasaññojanaṃ.
mn64:5.12: uppannassa ca kāmarāgassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti
mn64:5.13: tassa so kāmarāgo thāmagato appaṭivinīto orambhāgiyasaññojanaṃ.
mn64:5.15: uppannassa ca byāpādassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti
mn64:5.16: tassa so byāpādo thāmagato appaṭivinīto orambhāgiyasaññojanaṃ.
mn64:6.1: sutavā ca kho ānanda ariyasāvako ariyānaṃ dassāvī ariyadhammassa kovido ariyadhamme suvinīto sappurisānaṃ dassāvī sappurisadhammassa kovido sappurisadhamme suvinīto na sakkāyadiṭṭhipariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati na sakkāyadiṭṭhiparetena
mn64:6.2: uppannāya ca sakkāyadiṭṭhiyā nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
mn64:6.4: na vicikicchāpariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati na vicikicchāparetena
mn64:6.5: uppannāya ca vicikicchāya nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
mn64:6.7: na sīlabbattaparāmāsapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati na sīlabbattaparāmāsaparetena
mn64:6.8: uppannassa ca sīlabbattaparāmāsassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
mn64:6.10: na kāmarāgapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati na kāmarāgaparetena
mn64:6.11: uppannassa ca kāmarāgassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
mn64:6.13: na byāpādapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati na byāpādaparetena
mn64:6.14: uppannassa ca byāpādassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
mn64:6.16: yo ānanda maggo yā paṭipadā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ pahānāya taṃ maggaṃ taṃ paṭipadaṃ anāgamma pañcorambhāgiyāni saññojanāni ñassati vā dakkhati vā pajahissati vāti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
mn64:6.17: seyyathāpi ānanda mahato rukkhassa tiṭṭhato sāravato tacaṃ acchetvā phegguṃ acchetvā sāracchedo bhavissatīti
mn64:6.19: evameva kho ānanda yo maggo yā paṭipadā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ pahānāya taṃ maggaṃ taṃ paṭipadaṃ anāgamma pañcorambhāgiyāni saññojanāni ñassati vā dakkhati vā pajahissati vāti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
mn64:7.1: yo ca kho ānanda maggo yā paṭipadā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ pahānāya taṃ maggaṃ taṃ paṭipadaṃ āgamma pañcorambhāgiyāni saññojanāni ñassati vā dakkhati vā pajahissati vāti ṭhānametaṃ vijjati.
mn64:8.1: seyyathāpi ānanda mahato rukkhassa tiṭṭhato sāravato tacaṃ chetvā phegguṃ chetvā sāracchedo bhavissatīti ṭhānametaṃ vijjati
mn64:8.2: evameva kho ānanda yo maggo yā paṭipadā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ pahānāya taṃ maggaṃ taṃ paṭipadaṃ āgamma pañcorambhāgiyāni saññojanāni ñassati vā dakkhati vā pajahissati vāti ṭhānametaṃ vijjati.
mn64:8.3: seyyathāpi ānanda gaṅgā nadī pūrā udakassa samatittikā kākapeyyā
mn64:8.5: ahaṃ imissā gaṅgāya nadiyā tiriyaṃ bāhāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ gacchissāmīti
mn64:8.6: so na sakkuṇeyya gaṅgāya nadiyā tiriyaṃ bāhāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ gantuṃ
mn64:8.7: evameva kho ānanda yassakassaci sakkāyanirodhāya dhamme desiyamāne cittaṃ na pakkhandati nappasīdati na santiṭṭhati na vimuccati.
mn64:8.8: seyyathāpi so dubbalako puriso evameva te daṭṭhabbā.
mn64:8.9: seyyathāpi ānanda gaṅgā nadī pūrā udakassa samatittikā kākapeyyā
mn64:8.11: ahaṃ imissā gaṅgāya nadiyā tiriyaṃ bāhāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ gamissāmīti
mn64:8.12: so sakkuṇeyya gaṅgāya nadiyā tiriyaṃ bāhāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ gantuṃ
mn64:8.13: evameva kho ānanda yassakassaci sakkāyanirodhāya dhamme desiyamāne cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati vimuccati.
mn64:8.14: seyyathāpi so balavā puriso evameva te daṭṭhabbā.
mn64:9.1: katamo caānanda maggo katamā ca paṭipadā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ pahānāya.
mn64:9.2: idhānanda bhikkhu upadhivivekā akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānā sabbaso kāyaduṭṭhullānaṃ paṭippassaddhiyā vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn64:9.3: so yadeva tattha hoti rūpagataṃ vedanāgataṃ saññāgataṃ saṅkhāragataṃ viññāṇagataṃ te dhamme aniccato dukkhato rogato gaṇḍato sallato aghato ābādhato parato palokato suññato anattato samanupassati.
mn64:9.5: so tehi dhammehi cittaṃ paṭipāpetvā amatāya dhātuyā cittaṃ upasaṃharati
mn64:9.6: etaṃ santaṃ etaṃ paṇītaṃ yadidaṃ sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānanti.
mn64:9.8: no ce āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti teneva dhammarāgena tāya dhammanandiyā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
mn64:9.9: ayampi kho ānanda maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ pahānāya.

mn64:13.2: so yadeva tattha hoti vedanāgataṃ saññāgataṃ saṅkhāragataṃ viññāṇagataṃ
mn64:13.3: te dhamme aniccato dukkhato rogato gaṇḍato sallato aghato ābādhato parato palokato suññato anattato samanupassati. so tehi dhammehi cittaṃ paṭipāpeti so tehi dhammehi cittaṃ paṭipāpetvā amatāya dhātuyā cittaṃ upasaṃharati etaṃ santaṃ etaṃ paṇītaṃ yadidaṃ sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānanti. so tatthaṭṭhito āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti no ce āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti teneva dhammarāgena tāya dhammanandiyā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tatthaparinibbāyī

mn64:15.5: ayaṃ kho ānanda maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ pahānāyāti.
mn64:16.1: eso ce bhante maggo esā paṭipadā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ pahānāya atha kiñcarahi idhekacce bhikkhū cetovimuttino ekacce bhikkhū paññāvimuttinoti.
mn64:16.2: ettha kho tesāhaṃ ānanda indriyavemattataṃ vadāmīti.
mn64:16.4: attamano āyasmā ānando bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti.
